The '''Mechro-II''' was a model of [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]]<ref name="CSWE" /> manufactured by [[Kalibac Industries]]<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> for use in its [[NR-5 Series Repair Droid]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mechro-II was first mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] supplement written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
